products.title: Ferryl 400R Anticorrosive White Coating
products.focusKeyword: white flexible coating for hoses and cables
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl 400R is a white, flexible, one-component coating for rubber hoses, electrical cables and standing rigging on deck: it shields rubber from UV and salt and does not crack as wires vibrate. 12 kg drum.
products.descriptionLong:
Ferryl 400R is a white coating that dries like paint but stays flexible like plastic. It was made for two jobs paint and grease both do badly on deck: protecting rubber — hydraulic hoses, electrical cables, seals — and protecting standing rigging such as mast, stay and guy wires.

Rubber hoses and cables

Rubber stays soft because of plasticisers, and heat, sunlight and salt water drive them out until the rubber dries, cracks and fails — a leaking hydraulic hose or a short-circuited cable. Paint does not stick to rubber and cracks off; grease washes away. 400R is designed to adhere to rubber, flexes with it, and puts a white barrier between the rubber and the sun, slowing the loss of plasticisers and extending the life of the hose or cable.

Standing rigging

Mast and stay wires never stop vibrating, so a hard paint film soon cracks and lets salt water in, while grease drips and washes off. 400R dries completely but stays flexible, so it keeps protecting the wire, and it leaves a clean white finish.

How it performs

  • Plastic components keep the dry film flexible, so it does not crack under vibration or movement.
  • Chemically active rust inhibitors.
  • UV stabilisers for a long life in sunlight.
  • Adheres to most surfaces.
  • Resists oil, grease, petrol and salt water.
  • One component, ready to use, applied like paint by brush, roller or spray.

Preparation and thinning

Clean the surface with Ferryl 404 before coating; 404 also thins 400R if a different viscosity is needed and cleans the brushes afterwards.

Pack

12 kg metal drum.

Ferryl coatings

  • Ferryl 400R white coating
  • Ferryl 401 transparent coating
  • Ferryl 502 fluorescent orange-red coating
  • Ferryl 505 fluorescent yellow coating
  • Ferryl 404 thinner and surface cleaner

Related

  • Hydraulic hose
  • Why hydraulic hose reinforcement corrodes
  • Steel wire rope

products.title: Ferryl 401 Anticorrosive Transparent Coating
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl 401 is a clear, glossy, flexible coating that keeps stainless steel, brass, copper and aluminium fittings on deck bright and rust-free, cutting polishing and maintenance. 1 kg tin, single or packs of 10.
products.descriptionLong:
Even 316 stainless steel starts to stain and rust within a few years on an open deck — couplings, railings, brackets, signs and portholes all go brown. Ferryl 401 stops that before it starts: a clear, glossy, varnish-like coating with Ferryl rust inhibitors that seals the metal off from salt water while keeping its original look.

How it performs

  • Plastic components keep the dry film flexible, so it does not crack under vibration or movement.
  • Chemically active rust inhibitors.
  • UV stabilisers for a long life in sunlight.
  • Transparent and glossy — keeps the original appearance of the metal.
  • Adheres to most surfaces.
  • Resists oil, grease, petrol and salt water.
  • One component, ready to use, applied like paint by brush, roller or spray.

Surfaces

Steel, stainless steel, copper, aluminium, brass, light alloys and wood.

Where it is used

Handrails, couplings, pipes and fittings, door frames and knobs, nuts, engine parts, ventilators, signs, binnacles, portholes, instruments and fixtures.

Already rusting?

Remove the rust with Ferryl Ferrycid, clean with Ferryl 404, then coat with 401.

Pack

1 kg metal tin, single or in packs of 10.

Ferryl coatings

  • Ferryl 400R white coating
  • Ferryl 401 transparent coating
  • Ferryl 502 fluorescent orange-red coating
  • Ferryl 505 fluorescent yellow coating
  • Ferryl 404 thinner and surface cleaner

Related

  • Galvanic corrosion in fittings
  • Plating and corrosion on fittings

products.title: Ferryl 404 Dilution & Cleaning Liquid
products.focusKeyword: paint thinner and surface cleaner marine
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl 404 cleans dirt, oil and grease off a surface before coating, thins Ferryl coatings and most solvent-based paints, and cleans brushes, rollers and sprayers. 10 L can.
products.descriptionLong:
Ferryl 404 is the working partner of the Ferryl coatings. A coating only lasts as long as its grip on the surface, so 404 is used first to strip dirt, oil and grease; then, if needed, to thin the coating to the viscosity the job calls for; and finally to clean the tools.

What it does

  • Removes dirt, oil and grease before a coating goes on, for the best possible adhesion.
  • Dilutes Ferryl 400R, 401, 502 and 505 to the viscosity you need.
  • Works as a multipurpose thinner for most solvent-based paints, primers and varnishes.
  • Cleans brushes, rollers and spray equipment.

How to apply it

By brush, rag, spray, pouring or submersion.

Pack

10 litre metal can.

Ferryl coatings

  • Ferryl 400R white coating
  • Ferryl 401 transparent coating
  • Ferryl 502 fluorescent orange-red coating
  • Ferryl 505 fluorescent yellow coating
  • Ferryl 404 thinner and surface cleaner

products.title: Ferryl 502 Fluorescent Orange-Red Safety Coating
products.descriptionShort: Ferryl 502 is a fluorescent orange-red, flexible anticorrosive coating for marking lifeboats, life-saving gear, fire extinguishers, alarms, exits and crane hooks so they stand out in poor light. 1 kg tin.
products.descriptionLong:
Hazards and safety equipment are usually picked out in red or yellow paint, but ordinary paint is dull in fog, rain and darkness, fades in the sun and cracks at sea. Ferryl 502 uses fluorescent orange-red pigments that look far brighter, especially in low light, in a flexible coating that protects the steel underneath.

How it performs

  • Plastic components keep the dry film flexible, so it does not crack under vibration or movement.
  • Chemically active rust inhibitors.
  • UV stabilisers to hold the colour intensity.
  • Adheres to most surfaces.
  • Resists oil, grease, petrol and salt water.
  • One component, ready to use, applied like paint by brush, roller or spray.

Surfaces

Steel, plastic, fibreglass and painted surfaces.

Where it is used

Lifeboats and life-saving equipment, buoys, fire extinguishers, alarms and warnings, emergency exits and doorways, the bridge, low beams and steps, crane hooks.

For walkways, steps, ladders and zone markings, the yellow Ferryl 505 is the usual choice. Check your flag and class requirements for any marking colour that is regulated.
